emerald-grid.displayName: Emerald Grid (DO NOT USE AS ACCENT)

display.purpose: Hero name mark only. Never on more than one element per page.

headline.purpose: Contact section statement. One structural heading per page that carries full weight.

body.purpose: All prose. Max 65ch. text-wrap: pretty on multi-line.

label.purpose: Nav, metadata, tags, section dates. Uppercase + 0.15em tracking. Use sparingly — ≤5 elements per viewport.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Primary easing for all reveals, hovers, and entrance animations. High-fidelity ease-out-expo.

motion.name: ease-ios-drawer
motion.purpose: Accordion expand/collapse. iOS-class drawer physics — fast in, slow out.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: State transitions: color, opacity, border-color changes.

motion.name: duration-std
motion.purpose: Hover motion: x-translate, scale on project rows.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Entrance reveals: y + opacity, hero, section entries.

motion.name: duration-hero
motion.purpose: Hero display-name clip reveal. The longest duration on page; earns its pace by being the first motion seen.

components.name: Primary Action Link
components.description: Text-link CTA. Uppercase tracked label with bottom-border affordance. No background, no radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-size: 0.6875rem; font-family: 'OverusedGrotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--foreground); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); padding-bottom: 2px; text-decoration: none; display: inline-block; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Ghost Link
components.description: Secondary text link. No border at rest, arrow suffix. Used for external / supplementary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-size: 0.6875rem; font-family: 'OverusedGrotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--foreground-dim); text-decoration: none; display: inline-block; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--accent); transform: translateX(3px); }

components.name: Tag / Chip
components.description: Tech tag pill. Border-only, no fill. Pill radius. Used in project accordion and skills.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 0.625rem; font-family: 'OverusedGrotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--foreground-dim); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; cursor: default; user-select: none; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-tag:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--foreground); transform: scale(1.05); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Top navigation anchor. Label style, color: stone at rest.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-size: 0.625rem; font-family: 'OverusedGrotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--foreground-dim); text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Divider
components.description: 1px horizontal rule. The sole structural separator — border-color only.

narrative.overview:
This system is dark-native, precise, and spatial — like engineering drawings exhibited in a gallery. Every decision earns its place through geometry, not decoration. The dominant surface is near-black (#050505); type is warm off-white (#F5F0E8). A hairline emerald grid traces the blueprint metaphor without announcing it: background infrastructure, not foreground decoration.

The motion language is cinematic and technical: scroll-driven parallax, accordion reveals with iOS-class easing, GSAP-level orchestration, and Locomotive Scroll smoothness as the ambient layer. Animations are structural — they carry information about hierarchy, sequence, and space.

This system explicitly rejects: editorial/brutalist aesthetics, cream backgrounds, glassmorphism, hero-metric templates, identical card grids, hand-drawn SVG, and numbered section scaffolding.
keyCharacteristics: Satoshi display + OverusedGrotesk body — Grotesque authority
Flat elevation: depth through scale and whitespace, never shadow
Custom cursor as a craft signal
Accordion-based project rows — no card grids
Motion is material: every animation is load-bearing

rules.name: The Emerald Embargo Rule
rules.body: The emerald grid color (#10B981) is background infrastructure only. Never use it as an accent, link, button color, or interactive signal.

rules.name: The One Temperature Rule
rules.body: All colors are warm-tinted. Do not introduce cool-tinted neutrals without explicit justification.

rules.name: The Grotesque Unity Rule
rules.body: Satoshi and OverusedGrotesk are two registers of one voice. Do not introduce a serif, script, or second geometric sans.

rules.name: The Label Economy Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels at 0.15em / 0.625rem are used sparingly. If they appear on more than 5 elements per viewport, reduce.

rules.name: The Display Floor Rule
rules.body: Display letter-spacing never goes below -0.04em. Current target: -0.03em.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow at rest. Shadow is a state-change response only — and even then, prefer border-color shift over shadow.

rules.name: The One Glass Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter: blur() is used exactly once: the scrolled nav. Any second instance requires explicit justification.

dos: Use dark mode as the primary/default theme
Keep emerald grid at opacity ≤ 3% as background infrastructure only
Use Satoshi for display/headings and OverusedGrotesk for body/labels
Keep letter-spacing ≥ -0.04em on all display headings
Use text-wrap: pretty on all multi-line body paragraphs
Keep elevation flat at rest — no decorative shadows
Limit uppercase tracked labels to ≤5 elements per viewport
Use accordion rows (not card grids) for project listings
donts: Don't use the emerald grid color (#10B981) as any UI accent (Emerald Embargo)
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively — one canonical use: scrolled nav
Don't use cream/sand/warm-tinted near-white as a design choice
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text + gradient)
Don't use border-left or border-right > 1px as a colored accent stripe
Don't pair border: 1px solid + box-shadow: 0 Npx Mpx on the same element
Don't use border-radius > 16px on cards or containers
Don't use editorial-magazine aesthetics (serif, italic drop caps, broadsheet grid)
Don't add numbered section markers (01 · About) as default scaffolding
Don't add uppercase tracked eyebrows above every section heading
Don't use hand-drawn SVG or feTurbulence paper grain
Don't introduce cool-tinted neutrals or blue-gray into the palette
